title: Solid 3 stars. Mirror is nice, frame is okay.
text:
Solid 3 stars. Mirror is nice, frame is okay.. The best thing about this floor mirror is that there is NO ASSEMBLY REQUIRED!! (1 star) The bevel is nice, the actual mirror quality is top notch- no warping or thin parts (2 stars) The stand in back is mounted with 2 metal hinges which look pretty tight and secure, and there is a chain that connects stand to back of mirror to ensure the stand doesn't overextend. (3 stars) It's not wood and you can totally tell. And you can see from above pix how the frame is put together where angle's meet. (-1 star) I also don't care much for silver bead accent-looks kind of hokey to me.(-1 star)
I do not think it's sophisticated enough to use in a master bedroom. But will work out lovely in my daughter's room.
